summary: Iter_12 — Verified multi-resource + ActiveModifiersPanel + PUT merge bug fix. Backend: 7 new pytests in test_multi_resources.py all PASS — covers (a) resources array round-trip via PUT /api/pcs + GET /api/entries/{slug}; (b) THE BUG: builder-style PUT without `resources` (only name/player_name/level) preserves the existing resources array unchanged; (c) legacy single resource_* fields preserved when not sent (None ≠ clear); (d) explicit '' on resource_name does clear the legacy fields (deliberate-clear semantics intact); (e) third resource appended persists; (f) gated modifier scenario: tree node with level_required=10 + foundation_unlock binding round-trips; (g) extras allowed on resources entries (extra='ignore'). Frontend smoke (PC viewport, /characters/wawa): ANON view → resource-bars visible read-only, add-resource-btn HIDDEN, active-modifiers-panel visible. DM view → add-resource-btn visible, gear + +/- buttons on each bar, active-modifiers-panel toggle text '2 active', expanded shows modifier-group-str and modifier-group-int with contributing tree·node lines. Add-resource flow end-to-end: opened modal, filled Sand Charges max=5 color=#84CC16, save → bar appears → reload → still present (persistence verified). No console errors during the flow.

issues: Spec example said the bound Wickfire-tree node 'Ember Lash' should contribute +1 STR / -1 WIS. Live data shows the active modifier source as 'Mossblood · Greenwhisper' giving +4 STR / -3 INT. Functionality (tree·node·±value with totals) renders correctly; the spec-narrative example just doesn't match the seeded tree. Worth confirming the intended seed names/values.

No pending entries shown for wawa because no live tree binds a level_required>4 modifier to her. The render code is in place (`pending-modifier-<i>` testid found in source) and the supporting backend payload round-trips fine, but no QA can visually confirm the section without seeding such a binding. Recommend adding a permanent seed (e.g., a level-10 node already bound via foundation_unlock) so the pending UI is always demonstrable.

action_items: (Optional) Re-seed wawa's Wickfire tree → 'Ember Lash' node with modifiers {str:+1, wis:-1} so the docs/spec example matches reality, or update the spec text to reflect the current Mossblood/Greenwhisper seed.
(Optional) Add a permanent demo gated modifier (foundation_unlock to a level_required=10 node) on wawa so the 'Unlocks at higher levels' section is always visible for product/QA review.
(Carryover from iter_11) Investigate the small stray '0' rendered under HP/AC/Speed/Init StatBlocks — still visible in this iter's screenshot.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PUT /api/pcs: the bug fix correctly switches legacy resource_* keys to 'pop only on explicit empty string' semantics. The matching 5e-fields loop above still uses plain 'if v is not None' merging, which keeps the contract consistent (None = preserve, [] = clear). Document this convention near the loop so a future refactor doesn't reintroduce the regression.

PlayerCharacterIn.resources is Optional[List[dict]] with no nested model. extras='ignore' is on the outer model, but individual resource dicts are unvalidated — any keys are written straight to Mongo. Acceptable today, but if you add server-side rest math, lock the schema (id:str, name:str, max:int, current:int, color:str#hex).

metadata cleanup line `{k: v for k, v in metadata.items() if v not in ('', None)}` drops keys whose value is empty list / empty dict only on the create path (POST) but NOT on PUT (PUT line uses `('', None)` only). Mostly OK because resources=[] is unlikely to roundtrip from the UI, but if a user removes the last resource the array will persist as []. Fine for the panel but worth a note.

ActiveModifiersPanel deep-link to /magic/<slug>?node=<id> depends on tree slug being known at panel-render time. The hookup looks right in code; if a tree is renamed (slug changes), older foundation_unlocks pointing to the old slug would 404 — but they're stored by tree_id not slug, so the navigation will still find it via the API GET. OK.

EntryDetail.jsx legacy-properties exclusion list has grown again (now includes 'resources'). Iter_11 already flagged this; switching to an allowlist of metadata keys remains the cleaner long-term fix.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (anon read-only, DM add/edit/persist, modifiers panel render all verified)

If the screenshot/demo state should be 2 bars exactly, remove Sand Charges manually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter_12 ships: (a) PlayerCharacterIn.resources Optional[List[dict]]; POST initializes to []; PUT merges via 'if v is not None'. (b) The CRITICAL FIX in server.py PUT /api/pcs is on legacy resource_* fields: they only POP when client sends '' (explicit clear) — None preserves.
